status_initial: Select a template folder to get started.
header_subtitle: Create print-ready PDF dossiers starting from Word / Excel / PDF templates of each department.
card01_subtitle: Choose where Word / Excel / PDF templates live, and where to save generated PDFs.
card02_subtitle: Enter the person's details, then add them to the batch list (or generate a single PDF).
cb_autoopen: Open the destination folder when done
card03_subtitle: Pick the department → see the document list → generate the PDF.
lbl_department_hint: Selection updates the list below in real time.
help_tip_body:
Each template name decides department and number of copies.
Format:  DEPARTMENT_NUMBER_CODE.doc/.docx  (or .xls/.xlsx / .pdf)
Example:  SAFETY_2_SAF.docx   (2 copies per employee)
secure_label: 🔒  Everything stays on your computer · no data sent online
mb_no_docs_body: There are no (selected) templates for the chosen department.
tt_name: Full name of the new hire (e.g. John Smith).
tt_date: Company entry date in DD/MM/YYYY format. Use the mouse wheel on day/month/year to change quickly.
tt_dept: Assigned department: matching templates + ALL templates will be included.
tt_multidept: Select multiple departments to combine templates from all of them.
tt_autoopen: When done, automatically opens the output folder in File Explorer.
tt_choose_tpl: Pick the local folder containing Word/Excel/PDF template files.
tt_choose_out: Pick where to save the generated dossier PDFs.
tt_refresh: Re-scan all templates from the folder and refresh the list.
tt_depts: Add, rename or delete departments (edits reparti.txt).
tt_generate: Fill in templates, merge into a single PDF and save it to the destination.
tt_batch: Import an employee list from CSV/Excel and generate multiple PDFs in bulk.
tt_include: Uncheck to temporarily exclude this template without removing it from the folder.
bat_subtitle: Select CSV or Excel with columns Name, Date, Department.
bat_cols: Expected columns: Name · Date · Department [· Role · Notes]
bat_no_rows: No employees to process. Add people or import a file.
bat_inline_subtitle: Enter Name/Date above, choose the Department, then click Add person. Finally Generate all PDFs.
tt_batch_run: Generates one PDF for each person in the batch list.
tt_batch_add: Adds the current Name/Date/Department to the batch list.
tt_batch_del: Removes the selected rows from the batch list.
tt_batch_import: Imports people from CSV or Excel (columns: Name, Date, Department).
de_hint: Custom departments are saved in reparti.txt alongside the ones detected from templates.
